† [נְחֵת] vb. descend (𝔗 Syriac; v. BH (poet., and late));—
Pe. Pt. נָחִ֑ת Dn 4:10, 20 (both מִן־שְׁמַיָּא).
Haph. deposit, ב loc.: Impf. 2 ms. תַּחֵת (K§ 42, b)) Ezr 6:5 (GuHpt reads 3 mpl.); Imv. ms. אֲחֵת (K§ 15 d)) 5:15 (acc. rei); Pt. pass. pl. מְהַחֲתִין 6:1 (were) deposited.
Hoph. (WCG 225) be deposed: Pf. 3 ms. הָנְחַת Dn 5:20 (מִן־כָּרְסֵא).
